content.summary: Earlier this month, China imposed export restrictions on rare earth elements, affecting Western supply for energy, defense and electronics production.  In March, U.S. President Donald Trump invoked emergency powers to boost domestic production of critical minerals as part of a broad effort to offset China's near-total control of the sector.  The executive order directed federal agencies, including EXIM, to unlock permitting, funding and offtake agreements for critical minerals, including rare earths.
